alphabet.description: Alphabet of the phoneme string ("ipa" or "arpabet").

project_id.description: Project ID to create the session in. Omit to use the project implied by the API key.

extension_id.description: Uploaded Extension ID to load in the browser (from upload_extension).

persist.description: Whether to persist the context (cookies, storage) after the session ends. Default: false.

context.description: Attach a persistent browser context (cookies, storage) to the session.

extensionId.description: Uploaded Extension ID to load in the browser (from upload_extension).

viewport.description: Browser viewport size. Browserbase picks a default when omitted.

blockAds.description: Enable ad blocking in the browser. Default: false.

solveCaptchas.description: Enable automatic captcha solving. Default: true.

recordSession.description: Record the session (enables get_session_replays and recording downloads). Default: true.

logSession.description: Enable CDP-level session logging (enables get_session_logs). Default: true.

advancedStealth.description: Enable advanced stealth mode (requires a plan that includes it).

captchaImageSelector.description: Custom CSS selector for the captcha image element (custom captcha solving).

captchaInputSelector.description: Custom CSS selector for the captcha input element (custom captcha solving).

os.description: Operating system fingerprint for stealth mode.

allowedDomains.description: Restrict the session to these domains (e.g. ["example.com"]). All other navigation is blocked.

ignoreCertificateErrors.description: Ignore TLS certificate errors in the session. Use only for sites you control.

browser_settings.description: Browser configuration: context, viewport, stealth, recording, domain allow-list, and more.

timeout.description: Session timeout in seconds (60-21600). Defaults to the project defaultTimeout. The session ends automatically when this elapses.

keep_alive.description: Keep the session alive when the driver disconnects, so you can reconnect later. Default: false (disconnect ends the session).

anyOf.description: Enable Browserbase managed proxies with default settings.

country.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g. "US").

state.description: US state code, 2 characters (e.g. "CA"). Requires country "US".

city.description: City name; use spaces for multi-word names (e.g. "San Francisco").

geolocation.description: Optional geographic location for the proxy exit node.

domainPattern.description: Domain pattern this proxy applies to (e.g. "*.example.com"). Omit to proxy all domains.
Domain pattern this proxy applies to. Omit to proxy all domains.

type.description: Disable proxies for the matching domain pattern.

domainPattern.description: Domain pattern to exclude from proxying. Omit to disable proxies entirely.

anyOf.description: Ordered list of proxy configurations; the first matching domainPattern wins.

proxies.description: Proxy configuration: true for Browserbase managed proxies, or an array of proxy configs. Default: no proxies.

ca_certificates.description: IDs of uploaded CA certificates (from upload_certificate) to trust for TLS-inspecting proxies.

region.description: Region to run the browser in. Pick the region closest to the target site for lower latency. Default: us-west-2.

user_metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata to attach to the session (e.g. {"ticket": "ACME-123"}). Queryable later via list_sessions q filter.

start_at.description: Only agents created at or after this time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds (number, e.g. 1735689600000) or a parseable date string (e.g. "2026-01-01").

end_at.description: Only agents created at or before this time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds (number, e.g. 1735689600000) or a parseable date string (e.g. "2026-01-01").

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.

property_id.description: Optional GA4 property ID. Defaults to GA4_PROPERTY_ID.

order_by.description: Order field, prefix with - for descending.

template_uuid.description: Template ID (from list_templates or PandaDoc app URL)

role.description: Must match a role in the template

fields.description: Map of field names to values: { "FieldName": { "value": "text" } }

name.description: Name of the pricing table in the template to populate

data_merge.description: If true, all field names in data rows must be the external names defined in the template

default.description: If true, this is the default section

multichoice_enabled.description: If true, recipients can pick rows in this section

options.description: Row options (editable qty, optional row, pre-selected)

data.description: Row values keyed by column name, e.g. { "Name": "Widget", "Price": 10, "QTY": 3, "SKU": "widget-1" }

rows.description: Rows to populate in this section

pricing_tables.description: Pricing tables to populate. Requires "Automatically add products to this table" enabled on the template pricing table. All product info must be passed here — products stored in PandaDoc cannot be used.

metadata.description: Custom key-value metadata to associate with the document

folder_uuid.description: Folder ID to store the document in (see list_document_folders)

text.description: Text to speak. Max 1000 characters (5000 for eleven_v3, which also accepts audio tags like [laughs]).

voice.description: Voice preset name or custom voice UUID (custom voices require eleven_multilingual_v2). Default: Maya.
